componentType.description: Informational pack kind shown in plans and status.

version.description: Shown in status; bump it when the pack changes.

harnesses.description: Harnesses that receive the top-level files. Default: opencode when files is non-empty.

source.description: File or directory relative to the pack manifest.

destination.description: Workspace-relative destination. May use harness tokens: {agents} {skills} {commands} {tools} {mcp} {config} {dir}.

managed.description: false: installed once, recorded, never refreshed.

role.description: Free-form label recorded in the manifest (for example support).

installMode.description: copy: write the file. merge: merge a JSON fragment at jsonPointers. toml-merge: append TOML tables that are absent.

jsonPointers.description: JSON Pointers merged when installMode is merge.

render.description: frontmatter: replace the source's frontmatter with the YAML header. codex-agent: emit the TOML header plus developer_instructions from the body.

header.description: Header file relative to the pack manifest; required with render.
